ledgerRepresentation: Each local migration source is one text[] element; not Supabase CLI/provider statement parsing

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reach_contacts_id_owner_key ON public.reach_contacts USING btree (id, owner_id)
CREATE INDEX reach_contacts_linked_profile_idx ON public.reach_contacts USING btree (linked_profile_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reach_contacts_owner_linked_profile_uidx ON public.reach_contacts USING btree (owner_id, linked_profile_id) WHERE (linked_profile_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX reach_contacts_owner_status_idx ON public.reach_contacts USING btree (owner_id, status, updated_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reach_contacts_pkey ON public.reach_contacts USING btree (id)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_reach_contact_limit_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, owner_id ON public.reach_contacts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.enforce_reach_contact_limit()
CREATE TRIGGER sync_member_reach_counts_trigger AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.reach_contacts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.sync_member_reach_counts()
CREATE TRIGGER touch_reach_contact_updated_at_trigger BEFORE UPDATE ON public.reach_contacts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.touch_reach_contact_updated_at()

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (linked_profile_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
